how_to_choose: 看三套在「轮廓来源 / 材质 / 色温」上是否真的一眼可分；再由人确认（门禁 G2）

proposals.name: 水彩绘本 × 低多边形
proposals.reference_direction: 水彩绘本的轮廓与收边 + 低多边形的材质与纹理
proposals.outline: soft_bleed，线宽随物件尺寸线性变化
proposals.lighting: 平光，无方向；无方向光，靠固有色区分
proposals.camera: 俯视 45° 斜角，相机固定，关键事件 1.06 倍推近
proposals.camera_en: top-down 45 degree angle, fixed camera, slight zoom-in on key events
proposals.atmosphere: clean_flat 质感 + 水彩绘本 的空间感
proposals.ui_language: 线框 + 单一强调色（#F2C14A），圆角 0，描边 2px
proposals.character_design: 横向剪影，不做五官；每个角色只带一个高辨识度道具
proposals.positive_prompt: watercolor picture book illustration, soft pigment bleeding, cold-press paper grain, gentle washes, muted edges, children's book warmth, stone materials, clean_flat texture, flat even lighting, no directional shadow, no cast shadow, palette #0E1B2A #1B3A4B #2E5D6B with accent #F2C14A
proposals.negative_prompt: hard outline, digital gradient, 3d render, photo, neon, hand-drawn, watercolor, pixel art, high poly, photoreal, text, letters, watermark, extra limbs
risks: 透明度容易失控，抠图会带走浅色边缘
单张出图能看，成套一致性差
需要统一的相机角度否则像拼贴
proposals.differentiation: 与 S2 的区别：轮廓来自 水彩绘本，色相偏移 +0°，饱和度 +0.00

proposals.name: 像素 × 等距微缩
proposals.reference_direction: 像素的轮廓与收边 + 等距微缩的材质与纹理
proposals.outline: chunky_pixel，线宽随物件尺寸线性变化
proposals.lighting: 平光，无方向；无方向光，靠固有色区分
proposals.camera: 俯视 45° 斜角，相机固定，关键事件 1.06 倍推近
proposals.camera_en: top-down 45 degree angle, fixed camera, slight zoom-in on key events
proposals.atmosphere: clean_flat 质感 + 像素 的空间感
proposals.ui_language: 线框 + 单一强调色（#E5E656），圆角 0，描边 2px
proposals.character_design: 横向剪影，不做五官；每个角色只带一个高辨识度道具
proposals.positive_prompt: 16-bit pixel art, limited palette, hard pixel edges, dithering shading, no anti-aliasing, wood materials, clean_flat texture, flat even lighting, no directional shadow, no cast shadow, palette #111527 #212D45 #374B62 with accent #E5E656
proposals.negative_prompt: smooth gradient, blurry, vector, 3d render, high resolution detail, perspective vanishing point, side view, flat 2d, photo, text, letters, watermark, extra limbs
risks: AI 出不了精确像素网格，必须程序化重采样
低分辨率素材与高清 UI 会打架
等距比例必须写死，AI 会画出透视
proposals.differentiation: 与 S1 的区别：轮廓来自 像素，色相偏移 +18°，饱和度 -0.12

proposals.name: 黏土定格 × 超现实
proposals.reference_direction: 黏土定格的轮廓与收边 + 超现实的材质与纹理
proposals.outline: soft_bleed，线宽随物件尺寸线性变化
proposals.lighting: 光从右上方来；柔光，阴影边缘晕开
proposals.camera: 俯视 45° 斜角，相机固定，关键事件 1.06 倍推近
proposals.camera_en: top-down 45 degree angle, fixed camera, slight zoom-in on key events
proposals.atmosphere: noise_film 质感 + 黏土定格 的空间感
proposals.ui_language: 线框 + 单一强调色（#FC9940），圆角 0，描边 2px
proposals.character_design: 横向剪影，不做五官；每个角色只带一个高辨识度道具
proposals.positive_prompt: claymation stop-motion look, fingerprint texture, soft plasticine surfaces, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field, glass materials, noise_film texture, light from upper right, soft diffused shadows, palette #0B232D #164950 #267372 with accent #FC9940
proposals.negative_prompt: flat vector, pixel art, crisp digital, photo, cute, cartoon, flat vector, photo, text, letters, watermark, extra limbs
risks: 指纹纹理在 128px 下变成脏点
可读性最差，玩法元素必须高对比
AI 容易画成抽象噪声
proposals.differentiation: 与 S1 的区别：轮廓来自 黏土定格，色相偏移 -14°，饱和度 +0.10
